measurement_method: Environment Agency Defra Data Services Platform official dataset metadata for LIDAR Composite DSM - 2m
spatial_binding_method: Official published geographic extent converted directly to EPSG:4326 Polygon; source-area only

field_evidence.surface_semantics: DSM includes heights of surface objects such as buildings, vegetation and vehicles as well as terrain

limitations: This package is source-area coverage evidence only, not repository canonical parcel acceptance.
No building-footprint/canonical-parcel spatial join is established.
No official DEM/LIDAR min/max/mean/max-min statistics were computed for a building-containing canonical parcel.
